Pokémon Champion of Champions Tournament
Welcome to the Pokémon Champions: Champion of Champions Tournament LIVE from London!

After training with professional Pokémon VGC Champion, Ray Rizzo, we’ve brought together some of the world’s most unexpected elite competitors to compete for the ultimate title: Champion of Champions.
